sources.title: LFM3-Omni-2B - Liquid AI Docs
sources.snippet: 2B omni model that understands text, images, video, and audio, and answers in text, speech, or both ← Back to Omni Models LFM3-Omni-2B is Liquid AI’s first omni model: a single end-to-end model that understands text, images, video, and audio, and answers in text, speech, or interleaved text and speech.

sources.title: Liquid AI Launches LFM3 Family of Six Open-Weight 2B-Class Models
sources.snippet: Liquid AI announced LFM3 on October 27, 2026, a new generation of open-weight Liquid Foundation Models that brings text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models onto one shared backbone. The first release, detailed in a post on the Hugging Face blog, covers six models in the 2B parameter range. Six Models on One Shared Backbone Every LFM3 model branches from the same LFM3-1.7B-Base.
